title: DEM Architecture Explorer v2 — Verified Seed
description: Evidence-driven seed graph for the DEM architecture. This dataset is intentionally not declared exhaustive.

nodes.arabic_meaning: النموذج المعماري الشامل لمنصة مفتاح النيل وDEM
nodes.arabic_description: الإطار الأعلى الذي يربط تجربة الأعمال بالتطبيق والأنظمة الخارجية والحدود الرئيسية.
responsibilities: Provide the top-level mental model for the platform and DEM.
non_responsibilities: It is a documentation projection, not a runtime component.

evidence.detail: Defines Level 0 as the complete DEM Universe mental model.

nodes.arabic_description: واجهة التطبيق التي تشمل الصفحات والمكونات والخدمات والحالة والأنواع والاختبارات.
responsibilities: Provide the user-facing application interface.
non_responsibilities: Does not own backend business execution.

evidence.detail: Verified frontend structure including components, hooks, lib, locales, pages, services, store, test, and types.

nodes.arabic_description: نقطة دخول تطبيق backend التي تهيئ البنية الأساسية وتسجل المكونات والـrouters.
responsibilities: Expose HTTP application boundary.
Wire routers and runtime infrastructure during application startup.
non_responsibilities: Does not itself represent the downstream business services.

evidence.detail: Creates the FastAPI application and imports routers, infrastructure, knowledge, memory, and LLM components.

nodes.arabic_description: الجزء الخلفي الذي يضم الوكيل والبنية الأساسية والـrouters والخدمات والبحث والمعرفة.
responsibilities: Host the server-side application architecture.
non_responsibilities: Does not imply a microservices deployment model.

evidence.detail: Verified top-level backend areas agent, core, models, research, routers, schemas, and services.
Explicitly records modular-monolith-oriented architecture and warns against inventing microservices.

nodes.arabic_description: طبقة الذكاء التنفيذي التي تستقبل الطلبات وتنتج القرارات وتخطط التنفيذ وتنسقه عبر الأدوات والخدمات.
responsibilities: Coordinate session, reasoning, planning, execution, tools, knowledge, memory, approval, audit, and monitoring.
non_responsibilities: The Agent is not equivalent to the LLM alone and its tools are not the business services themselves.

evidence.detail: Verified Agent subsystem and its internal areas.
Requires Agent internals to remain explicitly discoverable.

nodes.arabic_description: طبقة سياق الجلسة التي يبدأ منها مسار تنفيذ طلب DEM.
responsibilities: Establish and carry session context into the agent flow.

evidence.detail: Verified Agent session area in repository inventory.

nodes.arabic_description: يحوّل نية المستخدم إلى بدائل وقرار مستفيدًا من الذاكرة والمعرفة، مع إمكانية تعزيز الاستدلال عبر مزود LLM.
responsibilities: Map intent to candidate paths.
Query memory and knowledge.
Evaluate and select an execution path.
Determine approval requirement.
Produce and persist significant decisions.
non_responsibilities: Does not itself execute business operations.

evidence.detail: ReasoningEngine.reason queries memory and knowledge, evaluates candidates, selects a path, checks approval, and creates a Decision.
ReasoningEngine is imported and instantiated as part of application wiring.

nodes.arabic_description: طبقة الوكيل التي تتعامل مع سجل ومنسق مزودي المعرفة، مع بقاء حدود Knowledge Ingestion منفصلة عن Research.
responsibilities: Provide knowledge access to agent reasoning through the knowledge registry/orchestration boundary.
non_responsibilities: Does not own external research, business analysis, plan generation, execution, or LLM orchestration.

evidence.detail: Verified knowledge subsystem directory.
Defines the bounded Knowledge Ingestion contract and explicitly excludes Research, Reasoning, Execution, and LLM orchestration.

nodes.arabic_description: طبقة الذاكرة التي يقرأ منها محرك الاستدلال ويكتب فيها القرارات المهمة عبر مزود SQLite الحالي.
responsibilities: Provide persistent/retrievable agent memory context.

evidence.detail: Instantiates SQLiteMemoryProvider with db_path=nile_key.db.
ReasoningEngine queries memory and persists significant decisions when a memory provider is configured.

nodes.arabic_description: تكامل اختياري مع مزود LLM لتعزيز اختيار المسار وصياغة الاستدلال عندما يكون المزود متاحًا.
responsibilities: Optionally enhance candidate selection and reasoning output through a configured LLM provider.
non_responsibilities: LLM is not the complete Agent architecture.

evidence.detail: ReasoningEngine retrieves a Gemini provider and uses it as an enhancement/fallback mechanism.
GeminiProvider and llm_registry are configured during application startup when LLM_API_KEY is available.

nodes.arabic_description: حد الحوكمة الذي يحدد ما إذا كان المسار المختار يحتاج إلى موافقة قبل التنفيذ.
responsibilities: Determine and gate approval requirements for decisions/execution.

evidence.detail: Verified approval subsystem directory.
ReasoningEngine constructs ApprovalGate and checks approval status for the chosen path.

nodes.arabic_description: منظومة بحث مستقلة تشمل الاسترجاع والمصادر والأدلة والجودة، وليست امتدادًا لحد Knowledge Ingestion.
responsibilities: Perform external research through retrieval, sources, evidence, orchestration, and quality components.
non_responsibilities: Does not collapse into Knowledge Ingestion.

evidence.detail: Verified research/orchestrator, quality, result, retrieval, sources, and evidence areas.
Explicitly excludes External Research from Knowledge Ingestion.

nodes.arabic_description: طبقة الخدمات التي تنفذ القدرات التشغيلية مثل الشحن والجمارك والفواتير والعملاء والمستندات وغيرها.
responsibilities: Implement business operations behind API and agent tool boundaries.
non_responsibilities: Business Services are not Agent Tools and are not equivalent to routers.

evidence.detail: Verified service modules including shipping, customs, invoice, customer, supplier, document, workflow, notification, resources, trade intelligence, export readiness, knowledge graph, audit, dashboard, and search.

nodes.arabic_description: قاعدة البيانات الحالية المستخدمة أثناء التشغيل، مع وصول مباشر عبر core/database.py.
responsibilities: Persist current runtime application data.
non_responsibilities: Not a PostgreSQL production migration target yet.

evidence.detail: Evidence inventory identifies SQLite/sqlite3 as the current runtime database implementation.
Application initializes the database and constructs SQLiteMemoryProvider against nile_key.db.

nodes.arabic_description: مسار مستقبلي موثق للترحيل، وليس قاعدة بيانات التشغيل الحالية.
responsibilities: Provide a bounded future migration target for production persistence.

evidence.detail: Documents the bounded PostgreSQL migration path while SQLite remains current runtime.
Backend is a confirmed application boundary in the repository.
Frontend is a confirmed application area.
FastAPI entry point wires backend routers and application components.
Agent is a backend subsystem.
Research is a backend subsystem.
Business services are a backend implementation area.
Current persistence implementation is SQLite.
Future PostgreSQL path is documented.
Session subsystem exists.
ReasoningEngine implementation exists.
Knowledge subsystem exists.
Memory subsystem exists.
LLM subsystem exists.
Approval subsystem exists.
reason() queries knowledge before evaluating options.
reason() queries memory and persists significant decisions.
ReasoningEngine optionally retrieves and uses a Gemini provider for enhancement.
ReasoningEngine constructs ApprovalGate and checks approval for the selected path.
SQLiteMemoryProvider is configured with db_path=nile_key.db.
Documents bounded future migration while preserving SQLite as current runtime.

notes: This is a verified seed, not the final exhaustive graph.

Intermediate Task Planner, Execution Planner, Execution Engine, Tool Orchestrator, Tool Registry, concrete tools, routers, schemas, core infrastructure, cross-cutting concerns, and individual business capabilities still require explicit reconciliation before completeness can be claimed.
No inferred ReasoningEngine-to-Business-Services edge is included; intermediate execution components must be modeled before asserting that runtime relationship at code level.
No runtime application behavior is changed by this dataset.
